name: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
problem: Serving a long-context chat workload needs to keep prefill and decode from interfering while also holding a KV cache far larger than GPU memory.
mechanism: Prefill and decode run in separate clusters; the KV cache itself becomes the scheduling currency and lives in a disaggregated pool spread across otherwise-idle CPU DRAM and SSD in the GPU cluster. The KVCache-centric scheduler trades cache-hit rate against latency SLOs to maximise effective throughput.
